user.title: iCloud Calendar (CalDAV)
user.description: Calendars and reminders from iCloud or another CalDAV server that you can add, change and delete from Home Assistant, including single occurrences of repeating events.

menu_options.copy_caldav: Copy the settings of the built-in CalDAV integration

copy_caldav.title: Copy CalDAV settings
copy_caldav.description: Uses the same server, account and password as the selected CalDAV entry. Remove that entry afterwards so calendars don't appear twice.

manual.title: iCloud Calendar (CalDAV)
manual.description: For iCloud use {icloud_url}, your Apple Account email and an app-specific password ({apple_account_url} → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords).

reconfigure.description: Update the CalDAV server connection for {username}.

data_description.password: Enter the password for {username} again. Leave it empty only if the server needs no password.
data_description.url: The address of the CalDAV server.

unexpected_response.message: Unexpected response from the CalDAV server.

event_not_found.message: Could not find the event {uid} on the server.

changed_elsewhere.message: This event was changed elsewhere in the meantime. Reload the calendar and try again.
